subtitle.zh: 从 CPU 传输到分布式 KV 存储设计
subtitle.en: From CPU transfers to distributed KV storage

description.zh: 拆解 Transfer Engine 与 Mooncake Store，用正确性、容量和故障实验理解分离式推理的数据通路。CPU/TCP 可完成核心练习，RDMA 与真实引擎集成作为硬件扩展。
description.en: Separate the Transfer Engine from Mooncake Store and study the data path through correctness, capacity, and failure experiments. CPU/TCP covers the core labs; RDMA and real engine integration are hardware-dependent extensions.

hoursPerDay.zh: 每天 2–3 小时；编译、RDMA 配置与集群调试另计
hoursPerDay.en: 2–3 hours a day; builds, RDMA setup, and cluster debugging are extra

prerequisites.zh: 熟悉 Linux、Python、多进程与基础网络；理解 KV cache、内存生命周期和简单性能测量。建议先完成一个推理引擎课程。
prerequisites.en: Know Linux, Python, multiprocessing, and basic networking. Understand KV cache, buffer lifetimes, and basic performance measurement. Complete an inference-engine course first.

hardware.zh: 受官方发行包支持的 Linux/CPU 环境可做 TCP 两进程传输；部分环境需编译。RDMA 实验需要兼容网卡、驱动与网络。真实推理集成需要所选引擎支持的 GPU；无这些设备可完成标明假设的模拟。
hardware.en: A Linux/CPU environment supported by the official package can run two-process TCP transfer; some environments require a build. RDMA needs compatible NICs, drivers, and networking. Real serving integration needs a supported GPU; simulations are available with assumptions clearly labeled.

zh: 分布式存储工程师
推理系统工程师
高性能网络工程师
en: Distributed storage engineer
Inference systems engineer
High-performance networking engineer

outcome.zh: 完成 CPU/TCP 正确性实验、异步生命周期图、Store 行为矩阵、性能与容量模型及故障恢复记录；形成可审阅的 KV 数据通路作品。
outcome.en: Deliver a CPU/TCP correctness experiment, asynchronous lifecycle diagram, Store behavior matrix, performance and capacity models, and recovery records as a reviewable KV data-path portfolio.

title.zh: 分清传输引擎与对象存储

lesson.zh: Mooncake Transfer Engine 解决已知内存区域之间的数据移动，Mooncake Store 则增加对象、元数据、放置和生命周期管理。两者有关系，但不是同一个接口，也不承担推理调度。Store 的控制信息与数据流通常走不同路径，画清这些路径才能定位瓶颈。第一天先选版本和实验边界，避免把集群论文中的架构描述直接当成当前默认配置。
lesson.en: The Mooncake Transfer Engine moves data between known memory regions, while Mooncake Store adds objects, metadata, placement, and lifecycle management. They are related but expose different responsibilities, and neither replaces inference scheduling. Store control information and bulk data typically follow different paths; mapping those paths helps locate bottlenecks. Start by choosing a release and an experimental boundary. A design described in a paper is not automatically the default configuration of the current software you are about to run.

task.zh: 画出调用方、Transfer Engine、Store client、master 与存储节点的关系图；分别用一次传输和一次 get 描述控制与数据消息。记录仓库 commit 或发布版本与文档核对日期。
task.en: Diagram the caller, Transfer Engine, Store client, master, and storage nodes. Trace control and data messages for one transfer and one get. Record the repository commit or release and the documentation-check date.

evidence.zh: architecture.md：组件责任表、两条路径图与固定版本清单。
evidence.en: architecture.md with responsibilities, two path diagrams, and a pinned-version manifest.

zh: 明确区分字节传输与对象管理
控制面和数据面箭头不同
图中不把 Mooncake 当成推理调度器
en: Distinguish byte transfer from object management
Use separate control- and data-path arrows
Do not depict Mooncake as the inference scheduler

noGpu.zh: 阅读设计与官方 CPU/TCP 示例，完成路径追踪；所有未运行的组件标注为设计分析。
noGpu.en: Read the design and official CPU/TCP example and trace both paths. Label components that were not run as design analysis.

title.zh: 跑通 CPU 上的两进程传输

lesson.zh: 传输最基本的正确性问题是目的端是否拿到了指定长度、指定内容的字节。官方 Transfer Engine 提供 CPU/TCP 两进程路径，可先理解初始化、内存注册、连接与传输，不必先配置 RDMA。进程可达、端口正确并不代表数据正确；校验和、边界长度与明确的完成状态才构成最小证据。包与平台不匹配时，应记录失败而不是假装硬件测试已完成。
lesson.en: The first transfer question is whether the destination received the intended bytes at the intended length. The official Transfer Engine includes a two-process CPU/TCP path, letting you study initialization, memory registration, connection, and transfer before configuring RDMA. Reachable processes and open ports do not establish data correctness. Checksums, boundary lengths, and explicit completion status provide the minimum evidence. If the package does not support your platform, record that limitation instead of presenting a substitute as a completed Mooncake hardware test.

task.zh: 在隔离本地环境按官方 CPU/TCP 示例启动发送与接收进程，保留版本。传输 1 KiB、64 KiB 和 1 MiB 的确定性字节数组，逐次核对长度与 SHA-256，保存完成状态。
task.en: Follow the official CPU/TCP example in an isolated local environment and record versions. Transfer deterministic 1 KiB, 64 KiB, and 1 MiB buffers, checking length and SHA-256 for each transfer and saving completion status.

evidence.zh: transfer-checks.csv：大小、源/目的摘要、状态及进程日志。
evidence.en: transfer-checks.csv with size, source/destination digests, status, and process logs.

zh: 至少 3 个大小的传输通过内容校验
失败与超时没有计入成功样本
记录传输后端为 TCP，而不是 RDMA
en: Validate contents at three buffer sizes
Exclude failures and timeouts from successful samples
Record TCP as the backend, not RDMA

noGpu.zh: 此练习本身可在受支持 CPU 环境运行。平台不兼容时用 Python socket 重现流程并明确标注替代实现，保留 Mooncake 安装失败记录。
noGpu.en: This lab runs on supported CPU environments. If your platform is incompatible, reproduce the flow with Python sockets, label it as a substitute implementation, and retain the Mooncake installation failure.

title.zh: 管理异步传输的内存生命周期

lesson.zh: 提交异步传输意味着任务被接受，不意味着远端字节已经可用。缓冲区注册、提交、轮询完成、释放资源有严格先后关系；在完成前复用内存可能产生难以重现的错误。批量任务部分失败时，部分目的字节也可能已经改变，不能简单把失败视为从未发生。需要用状态机描述所有权，并为超时和错误写出可恢复的处理规则。
lesson.en: Submitting an asynchronous transfer means work was accepted, not that the remote bytes are ready. Registration, submission, completion polling, and resource release have an ordering that protects buffer lifetime. Reusing memory before completion can produce intermittent corruption. A partially failed batch may already have modified some destination bytes, so failure is not equivalent to nothing happening. Model ownership as a state machine and define recoverable handling for timeouts and errors. Release memory only when the selected API's completion and cleanup requirements permit it.

task.zh: 画出 buffer 与 batch 的状态机，给每条边标注负责的进程。添加受控错误路径：连接失败、超时和部分任务失败；通过日志或模拟证明不会在未确认完成时复用/释放内存。
task.en: Draw buffer and batch state machines and label the process responsible for each transition. Add controlled connection-failure, timeout, and partial-batch-failure paths; use logs or simulation to show that memory is not reused or freed before completion is established.

evidence.zh: lifecycle.md 与至少 5 条状态转换测试记录；包括部分失败后的内容校验策略。
evidence.en: lifecycle.md and at least five transition tests, including a strategy for validating contents after partial failure.

zh: 提交与完成是两个独立状态
超时后不会立刻假定缓冲区可复用
部分失败有校验、重试或丢弃策略
en: Keep submission and completion as separate states
Do not assume a timeout makes a buffer reusable
Define validation, retry, or discard after partial failure

noGpu.zh: 写一个 asyncio 状态机模拟延迟完成与失败，用断言拒绝过早释放；这验证所有权逻辑，不证明底层传输的故障语义。
noGpu.en: Write an asyncio state-machine simulation with delayed completion and failures, asserting against early release. This validates ownership logic, not the transport's actual failure semantics.

title.zh: 理解 Store 的对象行为

lesson.zh: 对象存储让调用方用键与对象交互，而不是直接管理远端内存地址。Mooncake Store 的 master 维护对象位置等元数据，客户端按协议完成数据访问；元数据可见与数据可读必须按实际 API 语义理解。当前设计把对象视为写入后不可原地修改的内容，更新不能擅自当作传统可变字典赋值。先验证 put/get/remove 与缺失对象，再讨论性能。
lesson.en: Object storage lets callers work with keys and objects instead of directly managing remote addresses. Mooncake Store's master tracks placement metadata, and clients follow the protocol for data access; metadata visibility and readable data must be interpreted through the actual API. The current design treats stored objects as immutable rather than arbitrary mutable dictionary entries. Do not assume overwriting a key behaves like assignment in Python. Validate put, get, remove, and missing-object behavior before measuring performance or designing an application around them.

task.zh: 按固定版本的官方 Store 部署指南建立最小本地拓扑。用唯一键写入、读取、删除字节对象，测试缺失键与重复键的实际行为；每次读取校验内容，不推断未测试的并发一致性。
task.en: Use the pinned Store deployment guide to create a minimal local topology. Put, get, and remove byte objects under unique keys, then test missing and duplicate keys. Validate contents on every read without claiming untested concurrency guarantees.

evidence.zh: store-behavior.csv 与拓扑配置：每个操作的预期、返回状态、摘要及版本。
evidence.en: store-behavior.csv and topology configuration, recording expectations, returned status, digests, and versions for each operation.

zh: 至少覆盖写入、读取、删除、缺失与重复键
读取内容与原始对象摘要一致
说明不可变对象对更新设计的影响
en: Cover put, get, remove, missing, and duplicate keys
Match retrieved content to original digests
Explain how immutable objects affect updates

noGpu.zh: 优先使用受支持的 CPU/TCP Store 路径；环境无法部署时用显式不可变对象模型完成行为表，并列出仍需真实验证的返回语义。
noGpu.en: Prefer a supported CPU/TCP Store path. If deployment is unavailable, use an explicitly immutable object model and list return semantics that still need real validation.

title.zh: 测量吞吐与延迟的边界

lesson.zh: 小对象的完成时间容易被固定开销主导，大对象更容易受带宽和内存复制限制；增加并发能提高吞吐，也可能拉长排队和尾延迟。只报告总字节除以时间会掩盖失败、预热与并发差异。先明确测的是单次操作延迟还是稳定吞吐，再固定 CPU、网络、数据大小与后端。TCP 本地结果能够检验方法，不能替代 RDMA 或跨机结论。
lesson.en: Fixed overhead often dominates small transfers, while large transfers are more exposed to bandwidth and memory-copy limits. Concurrency can raise throughput while increasing queueing and tail latency. Reporting only total bytes divided by elapsed time can hide failures, warmup, and workload differences. Define whether you are measuring individual operation latency or steady throughput, then pin CPU, networking, data sizes, and backend. Local TCP results validate a measurement method, but cannot establish RDMA performance or behavior across machines.

task.zh: 选择 3 个对象大小与 3 个并发档位，每组重复至少 3 次；保存成功/失败数、传输字节、耗时和延迟样本。区分 MiB/s 与 Gb/s，画出大小、并发与吞吐/尾延迟关系。
task.en: Choose three object sizes and three concurrency levels, repeating each at least three times. Save successes, failures, bytes, elapsed time, and latency samples. Distinguish MiB/s from Gb/s and plot size/concurrency against throughput and tail latency.

evidence.zh: bench.csv、测量方法与两张图；包含预热和统计窗口说明。
evidence.en: bench.csv, measurement methods, and two charts, with warmup and measurement-window definitions.

zh: 所有结果保留后端、对象大小、并发与重复编号
失败样本单独统计
单位换算正确且没有外推未测网络
en: Keep backend, size, concurrency, and repeat ID for every result
Count failures separately
Use correct units without extrapolating to unmeasured networks

noGpu.zh: 直接测本机 CPU/TCP，或使用下方成本模型做参数敏感性分析；模拟结果不可命名为 Mooncake benchmark。
noGpu.en: Measure local CPU/TCP directly or use the cost model below for sensitivity analysis. Do not name simulated results a Mooncake benchmark.

caption.zh: 仅用于敏感性分析的传输下界模型；不包含排队、复制或协议开销，不是 Mooncake 实测。
caption.en: A transfer lower-bound model for sensitivity analysis only; it excludes queues, copies, and protocol overhead and is not a Mooncake measurement.

code.content:
# Assumed parameters; these are not measured Mooncake results.
fixed_us = 40
for size_mib in (1, 16, 256):
    for rate_gbps in (10, 25, 100):
        bytes_count = size_mib * 1024**2
        transfer_ms = (bytes_count * 8 / (rate_gbps * 1e9)) * 1000
        lower_bound_ms = fixed_us / 1000 + transfer_ms
        print(size_mib, rate_gbps, round(lower_bound_ms, 3))

lesson.zh: 副本能够提供更多可访问位置，也会消耗额外容量与写入带宽；副本数并不等于任意故障下都可读。需要结合放置位置、节点失效、元数据状态与清理机制讨论可用性。容量表应同时记录有效对象字节、预留空间、复制开销与回收余量。当前版本的恢复机制要以文档和实际配置为准，不能沿用旧架构中关于高可用性的结论。
lesson.en: Replicas provide additional locations for reads but consume capacity and write bandwidth. A replica count does not guarantee readability under every failure: placement, node loss, metadata state, and cleanup all matter. A capacity worksheet should account for live object bytes, reserved space, replication, and reclamation headroom. Recovery mechanisms must be checked against the current release and actual configuration. Do not carry forward an old architecture's availability claims when the implementation has changed, and do not infer durability solely from multiple in-memory copies.

task.zh: 为三个节点、两类对象设计容量与放置表，计算不同副本目标下的可用容量。按当前实现约束模拟一个节点下线，记录哪些对象仍可读、哪些元数据需要更新及恢复前提。
task.en: Design capacity and placement tables for three nodes and two object classes. Calculate usable capacity for different replica targets. Simulate one node becoming unavailable under current implementation constraints, recording readable objects, metadata changes, and recovery prerequisites.

evidence.zh: placement.csv、容量公式与单节点故障推演；真实实验与纸面推演分开。
evidence.en: placement.csv, capacity formulas, and a single-node failure analysis, separating live experiments from paper exercises.

zh: 容量包含副本和预留空间
解释副本、可用性与持久性之间的区别
恢复假设与当前版本文档一致
en: Include replicas and reserved space in capacity
Distinguish replication, availability, and durability
Align recovery assumptions with current-version documentation

noGpu.zh: 用集合模拟节点到对象的映射，移除一个节点后计算剩余副本数；测试器只证明所写放置模型，不证明 Store 已实现相同策略。
noGpu.en: Represent node-to-object placement with sets, remove one node, and count remaining replicas. The test validates your placement model, not an assertion that Store implements that exact policy.

title.zh: 选择一条推理集成路径

lesson.zh: Mooncake 可以出现在不同 KV 数据路径中：同一请求的 prefill/decode 交接，或跨请求共享缓存的存取。选择 Transfer Engine、Store 或上层缓存集成，取决于引擎当前支持和你的目标。成功移动字节不是推理正确性的充分条件；状态布局、模型版本、块大小和设备支持都要匹配。一次只验证一条官方路径，避免把多个项目的参数拼成未经支持的组合。
lesson.en: Mooncake can participate in different KV paths: handing state from prefill to decode within one request, or storing shared cache for later requests. Choosing Transfer Engine, Store, or an upper-layer cache integration depends on current engine support and the goal. Moving bytes successfully is not enough to establish correct inference; state layout, model version, chunking, and device support must align. Validate one documented integration at a time instead of assembling parameters from several projects into an unsupported combination.

task.zh: 在 SGLang、vLLM 或 LMCache 的官方集成中选一条，列出版本、硬件、依赖和支持边界。画一条请求时序图；有硬件时执行最小正确性验证，无硬件时提交可审查配置与待验证清单。
task.en: Choose one official SGLang, vLLM, or LMCache integration and list versions, hardware, dependencies, and support limits. Draw a request sequence diagram. Run minimal correctness checks if hardware is available; otherwise submit a reviewable configuration and validation checklist.

evidence.zh: integration-plan.md 与配置副本；注明选的是 P/D 交接还是共享缓存。
evidence.en: integration-plan.md and configuration copies, explicitly identifying P/D handoff or shared caching.

zh: 目标只包含一条已查证的官方集成路径
标注每个组件的版本与硬件条件
有端到端正确性计划，而不仅是带宽目标
en: Choose one verified official integration path
Record component versions and hardware requirements
Include end-to-end correctness checks, not only a bandwidth target

noGpu.zh: 完成配置审查和事件时间线，把 GPU、模型权重与真实请求验收列为待运行项；不生成虚构性能数字。
noGpu.en: Review configuration and produce an event timeline, marking GPU execution, model loading, and request validation as pending. Do not fabricate performance numbers.

title.zh: 处理共享、隔离与对象生命周期

lesson.zh: 共享 KV 的价值来自重复工作可以复用，但共享边界必须与状态兼容和数据权限一致。命名空间、租户配置与对象键各有职责，不能把名字不同当作完整访问控制。模型更新、对象驱逐、使用结束与节点重启也会影响对象是否仍可使用。设计时先定义谁能写、谁能读、何时失效，再核对当前版本确实提供哪些机制。
lesson.en: Shared KV is valuable when it avoids repeated work, but sharing boundaries must respect state compatibility and access permissions. Namespaces, tenant configuration, and object keys serve different purposes; different names are not a complete access-control system. Model updates, eviction, end of use, and node restarts also affect whether objects remain usable. Define who may write, who may read, and when state expires before checking the mechanisms offered by the current release. Unimplemented controls belong in a gap list, not in a claim of tenant safety.

task.zh: 使用测试租户 A/B 和合成字节，设计允许共享、应隔离、对象已删除与模型已更新四组用例。检查官方 sharing/isolation 配置的默认值与启用条件，在自己控制的环境中验证可验证部分。
task.en: Using test tenants A/B and synthetic bytes, design permitted-sharing, required-isolation, deleted-object, and model-updated cases. Check defaults and activation conditions in the official sharing/isolation guide, then validate available controls in an environment you own.

evidence.zh: isolation-matrix.csv 与生命周期图；将命名空间、授权和状态兼容分列。
evidence.en: isolation-matrix.csv and a lifecycle diagram, with separate columns for namespaces, authorization, and state compatibility.

zh: 至少覆盖共享、隔离、删除和模型更新
没有将默认配置宣称为自动安全隔离
每个控制标明已验证或仍需上层实现
en: Cover sharing, isolation, deletion, and model updates
Do not claim defaults provide automatic secure isolation
Mark each control as verified or requiring an upper layer

noGpu.zh: 用本地键值模型实现租户策略和删除测试；注明这是你定义的策略模拟，不能代替 Mooncake 配置验证。
noGpu.en: Implement tenant rules and deletion tests in a local key-value model. Label this as a simulation of your policy, not validation of Mooncake configuration.

lesson.zh: 分布式数据路径的失败可能发生在客户端、传输层、数据节点或元数据服务。单个超时无法说明哪个组件出错，也无法说明对象是否已经部分写入。用统一请求标识、状态码、字节计数与时间线连接证据，才有机会区分拥塞、容量不足和组件失联。恢复完成的标准应包括后续请求正确与资源可回收，而不只是进程重新启动。
lesson.en: Failures can occur in the client, transport, data nodes, or metadata service. A single timeout does not identify the failed component or establish whether data was partially written. Correlate request identifiers, statuses, byte counters, and timelines to distinguish congestion, exhausted capacity, and unreachable components. Recovery should mean that subsequent requests are correct and resources can be reclaimed, not merely that a process restarted. Test one bounded fault in a private environment and document any behavior you could not verify.

task.zh: 对本地测试拓扑实施一次有界故障：停止一个自己启动的进程或耗尽小型测试容量。记录故障前、中、后读写、摘要、指标及资源；恢复后重复正确性测试，编写运行手册。
task.en: Inject one bounded fault into your local topology: stop a process you started or exhaust a small test capacity. Capture reads/writes, digests, metrics, and resources before, during, and after it. Repeat correctness checks after recovery and write a runbook.

evidence.zh: failure-timeline.csv、脱敏日志与 runbook.md；写清故障注入与撤销步骤。
evidence.en: failure-timeline.csv, redacted logs, and runbook.md, including injection and rollback steps.

zh: 故障只作用于自己控制的测试环境
恢复后重新校验数据与操作结果
记录无法确认的对象与资源状态
en: Limit the fault to your controlled test environment
Revalidate data and operation outcomes after recovery
Record object and resource states that remain uncertain

noGpu.zh: 让模拟节点在固定操作序号失联，验证检测、超时、恢复与校验流程；给所有故障时间和恢复指标标注模拟来源。
noGpu.en: Make a simulated node disappear at a fixed operation number and test detection, timeout, recovery, and validation. Label all fault timings and recovery metrics as simulated.

title.zh: 交付 KV 数据通路作品

lesson.zh: 十天项目的价值是展示你能建立正确模型、设计可复现实验并识别结论边界。报告既要回答数据是否正确，也要回答哪种对象大小与并发适合当前路径、共享有什么前提、失败后如何处理。将 CPU/TCP 实测、RDMA 计划、GPU 集成与纯模拟分层陈述，让评审知道哪些能力已经验证、哪些仍待硬件，而不是用一个吞吐数字概括系统。
lesson.en: A ten-day project demonstrates that you can build a correct model, design reproducible experiments, and identify the limits of a conclusion. The report should establish data correctness, suitable object sizes and concurrency, sharing prerequisites, and failure handling. Present measured CPU/TCP results, RDMA plans, GPU integration work, and simulations as distinct evidence categories. This lets reviewers understand what is verified and what still requires hardware, rather than reducing a distributed system to a single throughput figure or overstating production readiness.

task.zh: 整理一个可复现作品，包含架构、版本、传输校验、Store 行为、性能表、容量推演、故障报告和下一步计划。用一页解释：何时应采用 Mooncake，何时更简单的本地方案就够用。
task.en: Package architecture, versions, transfer checks, Store behavior, benchmark tables, capacity analysis, failure reports, and next steps into a reproducible portfolio. Explain in one page when Mooncake is appropriate and when a simpler local approach is sufficient.

evidence.zh: 项目 README、实验原始数据和工程决策记录；可作为分布式存储或推理岗位的作品链接。
evidence.en: A project README, raw experimental data, and an engineering decision record for distributed-storage or inference-role applications.

zh: 至少一个正确性结果与一个性能/成本结果可复算
清楚区分 TCP、RDMA、GPU 与模拟证据
包含不适用场景和未完成验证
en: Make at least one correctness and one performance/cost result reproducible
Distinguish TCP, RDMA, GPU, and simulated evidence
Include unsuitable scenarios and uncompleted validation

noGpu.zh: 以 CPU 数据通路项目交付完整成果，附可在有硬件后继续执行的验证清单；无需把尚未运行的部分包装成完成。
noGpu.en: Deliver the complete CPU data-path project with a checklist for future hardware validation. Do not present unexecuted work as completed.
